notes: Approved Plushbound component packs are registered here by stable component ID.
The editor assembles registered layers only; it does not invent, raster-paint, or visually infer missing clothing/body parts.
Component art is produced upstream and imported as source layers. World Editor owns deterministic assembly and compatibility validation.
Important story characters, Guardians, bosses, and other bespoke characters may continue to use the locked atlas/compiler pipeline instead of this modular generator.
